node.title: Logo Intro
node.description: Logo Intro starts on your logo alone, then types your wordmark into place. Drop in your logo, set the text and font, and dial the media size, speed, and colors

node.title: Rubiks
node.description: Flips through your text letter by letter; stack any word, set the font and stretch, and dial the size, speed, and color to match your scene.

node.title: Gooey Text
node.description: Wraps your words in a soft, blobby outline that gently wobbles and breathes, layered in up to three colors. Set your font and text, then dial in movement frequency and speed, blob size, bleed, and each layer's color.

node.title: Media Opener
node.description: Top and bottom text rise into place, then pull apart to unveil your image or video in the gap between them. Set the media ratio, dial the width, adjust border and shadow, and control the reveal speed.

node.title: Text Cascade
node.description: Text Cascade stacks each letter into a trailing echo. Drop in any font, dial the size, set your colors, and control exactly how long the trail lingers behind.

node.title: Fold Distort
node.description: Text splits into two halves that fold, rotate, and distort through a dramatic 3D crease animation. Set left and right text independently, then control speed, hold time, font, and color.

node.title: Universe One
node.description: Create a bold impression with a sleek copy layout, opening gate transition, and a rhythmic image sequence synced to the music.

node.title: Text Scroll
node.description: A vertical ticker of pill-shaped tags that scrolls through your list of words.

node.title: Line-Halftone Kinetic Text
node.description: Text rendered as animated vertical scan lines that ripple and shift like a CRT display.

node.title: Blur Field Kinetic Text
node.description: Your text shrinks and grows in a perspective wave while a blurry, flowing color field pulses behind it.

node.title: Text Morph
node.description: Your phrases blur and morph into each other in a smooth, liquidy transition. Adjust font, color, speed, hold time, and blur amount.

node.title: Media Drop
node.description: Cards fall and stack with a satisfying physics-like drop. Upload multiple images and control card size, radius, jitter, spread, speed, and hold time for a loose, organic pile effect.

node.title: Media Wheel
node.description: A stack of images that loops on a curved carousel path. Upload multiple cards and tweak size, gap, radius, curve, speed, and motion type.

node.title: Donut Text
node.description: Two-part text that spins and warps into a wobbly, bulging loop. Control speed, bulge, vertical position, letter spacing, font, and separate colors for each half.

node.title: Rainbow Trail
node.description: Two text lines surf a rolling multicolored wave. Customize wave speed, gradient stops, outline color, and lead softness.

node.title: ASCII Filter
node.description: Converts your image or video into a grid of characters that recreates it in text form. Choose your font, character set (symbols or others), detail level, contrast, and character and background colors.

node.title: Text Particles
node.description: Your text assembles and dissolves as a swarm of glowing particles. Control spread, size, particle color, particle size, density, and speed

node.title: 3D Book Mockup
node.description: Wraps your image into a realistic 3D book with a spine and shadow. Upload any cover, then adjust thickness and spine color to match your look.

node.title: Deboss
node.description: Text pressed into your background image like a physical stamp. Adjust font, size, opacity, emboss depth, softness, background texture, and light angle.

node.title: Inflated Text
node.description: Puff text up into a 3D bubble

node.title: Kinetic Dot Glitch
node.description: Your text rendered as a dot matrix that glitches, scatters, and reforms in an animated loop. Tweak text size, line spacing, dot size, effect speed, transition, and seed for a different chaos pattern

node.title: Blurred Orb
node.description: Cards drift and tumble erratically through soft-focus space; adjust rotation speed, erraticness, item size, border radius, spacing, distortion, and edge blur.

node.title: Magazine Flip
node.description: Page spreads curl and flip through like a magazine; set page copies, scale, curl amount, speed, and cover hold time.

node.title: Machine
node.description: Your assets wrap around a tilted, rotating conveyor-belt cylinder; set roller diameter, belt thickness, spacing, corner rounding, speed, and shading.

node.title: Bentos
node.description: A scrolling bento-style grid cycles through your assets; set spacing, corner rounding, and scroll speed.

node.title: Spinning Wheel
node.description: Images stack and rotate vertically like a cylindrical wheel; set repeat count, corner rounding, vignette, spin direction, and speed.

node.title: Flipping Frame
node.description: A card that spins to reveal a second side, with title and label text floating off in 3D as it rotates. Customize front/back media, titles, labels, flip direction, corner rounding, media scale, hold time, fonts, and colors.

node.title: Extruded Logo
node.description: Your logo or image extrudes into a flat 3D shape with a beveled edge; set material color, polish, and brightness.

node.title: Logo Mask
node.description: Your logo or image cuts out as a solid silhouette filling the frame, animating in and out from a single point; crop or remove background, set scale, color, transition style, easing, and speed.

node.title: Portfolio Cube
node.description: A scattered grid of cards spins and reassembles into a focused image, cycling through your media. Set assets per page, corner radius, scale, speed, and layout/asset seeds.

node.title: Cube Slides
node.description: A 3D cube rotates between image faces, each paired with top/bottom text that slides in; set font, color, spacing, and speed.

node.title: Fire Text
node.description: Text engulfed in animated flames flickering up from each letter; set font, text, size, line height, glow spread, colors, and outline-only mode.

node.title: Glow Outline
node.description: Your image's outline draws itself in a glowing neon line, animating around the silhouette until fully lit.

node.title: CRT Text Glow
node.description: Bold text rendered as a glowing CRT/scanline display; set font, text, size, color, plus glow, scanlines, chromatic aberration, vignette, pixel size, curvature, noise, and flicker.

node.title: Gradient Sweep
node.description: A soft glowing color gradient shifts smoothly both around the outline and inside your image's silhouette; remove background, set up your colors, blur radius, and cycle speed.

node.title: Select Shine
node.description: A simulated cursor moves in to click your image, triggering a glowing shine sweep and pulsing selection ring; customize cursor style/size/direction, animation duration, and the ring's size, pulse, and color.

node.title: Gallery Fly Through
node.description: Your images grow and float past the camera at varying depths and sizes; set asset size, corner radius, spawn rate, speed, and seed.

node.title: Popcorn Pills
node.description: Colorful pill-shaped tags with your words tumble and pile up across the screen; set font, text lines, scale, spawn speed, drain-and-repeat, and colors.

node.title: Distorted Text Tube
node.description: Glowing text repeats and stretches outward in a chromatic, tunnel-like pattern; tweak font, text, color, size, line/repeat spacing, cycle speed, distortion, glow, and chromatic aberration.

node.title: Glass Text
node.description: Extruded 3D text with a reflective, glass-like surface; customize font, text, size, extrude depth, distortion, roughness, chromatic aberration, and reflection strength.

node.title: 3D Rotation Showcase
node.description: A grid of cards each holds briefly, then rotates in 3D to reveal your next image; set hold time, transition speed, corner radius, and card size

node.title: Flip Through Cards
node.description: Stacked cards cycle through; control spacing, corner roundness, fill/fit sizing, and flip speed.

node.title: Prism Logo
node.description: 3D text with a soft iridescent sheen; apply a color tint, and add surface scratches.

node.title: Percentage Bar
node.description: A circular fill rises to show a percentage, with a wavy liquid-like edge; set font size, percentage, text/background/bar colors, animate in/out, and waves.

node.title: Image Pinwheel
node.description: Your media spawn outward and spiral into a swirling pinwheel collage; set asset size, corner radius, spawn rate/radius, growth speed, and spiral speed/tightness.

node.title: Fisheye Carousel
node.description: Images arc through a curved, fisheye-warped carousel; set speed, spacing, corner radius, lens radius/strength, and step mode.

node.title: Text Focus
node.description: A grainy, blurred text grid pulses through soft focus while colors and contrast invert; set font, text, size, line spacing, shift amount/speed, color invert rate, blur strength/scale, and colors.

node.title: Heatmap
node.description: Turns your photo into a thermal, heat-mapped version of itself. Pick your color range and adjust the blur and brightness until it looks how you want.

node.title: Glow Cycle
node.description: Text that pulses with a slow, glowing light cycle. Pick your colors, adjust the spread, outline, and crunch to control how the glow builds and fades.

node.title: Iridescent Background
node.description: A shifting gradient that never sits still. Pick your colors and tweak the noise, warp, grain, and speed.
